animal_welfare.unit_of_concern: individual animal plus regional welfare landscape
animal_welfare.success_boundary: handoff or placement is not success without verified stable welfare outcome

mbg_public_nutrition.desired_state: safe reliable equitable nutrition service with measurable beneficiary outcome
structural_examples: new SPPG only after residual need
mbg_public_nutrition.success_boundary: meal production or delivery is not nutrition impact without outcome evidence

non_transfer_rule: Only the evidence-transition-access/integrity-intervention-authority-outcome architecture is shared. Animal-specific welfare, ownership, capture, return, population-control and veterinary rules must never be applied to human beneficiaries. Human rights, entitlement, consent/autonomy, privacy, procurement, audit, due-process and political-accountability rules must remain inside the human-domain constitution and must never be inferred from animal-welfare logic.
